title: Observation of a New Co-F Compound Detected by Very-High-Energy X-ray Diffraction During Thermal Decomposition of CoF3
abstract: Abstract                In situ diffraction studies of structural transformations occurring during thermal decomposition of a cobalt fluoride-CoF3-were performed using a very-high-energy (89 keV) synchrotron radiation. The real-time evolution of the crystal lattice was followed as a function of temperature. A new compound appearing as intermediate in the course of the decomposition from CoF3 to CoF2 was discovered.
